Book correction: The book prints the function in Example 1 without its minus signs, as x^{3}\ \ 2x^{2} + 4x\ \ 1. The book's own solution uses f(x) = x^{3} - 2x^{2} + 4x - 1, which is the correct function. Also, the book's solution labels the last part "(iv)" a second time; it is part (v), f\left(\frac{1}{x}\right).
